name: John Quincy Adams
role: US secretary of state (1817–1825), president (1825–1829), and representative (1831–1848)
summary: Adams defended constitutional republican government and promoted national investment in transport, education and science. His later congressional career centered on resisting slavery’s expansion and defending the right to petition. He advocated restraint in foreign wars while supporting US territorial and commercial interests.
